p.src: 1  Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

en: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?
u.src: 1  Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

p.src: 2  You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.

en: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.
u.src: 2  You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.

p.src: 3  You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.

en: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.
u.src: 3  You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.

p.src: 4  You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

en: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.
u.src: 4  You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

p.src: 5  Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

en: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?
u.src: 5  Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

p.src: 6  But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

en: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
u.src: 6  But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

p.src: 7  Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

en: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
u.src: 7  Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

p.src: 8  Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

en: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.
u.src: 8  Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

p.src: 9  Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.

en: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.
u.src: 9  Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.

p.src: 10  Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

en: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.
u.src: 10  Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

p.src: 11  Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.

en: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.
u.src: 11  Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.

p.src: 12  Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?

en: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?
u.src: 12  Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?

p.src: 13  Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”

en: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”
u.src: 13  Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”

p.src: 14  Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.

en: Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.
u.src: 14  Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.

p.src: 15  For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”

en: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”
u.src: 15  For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”

p.src: 16  But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.

en: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.
u.src: 16  But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.

p.src: 17  To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.

en: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.
u.src: 17  To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.
